summary: Productivity & Focus Monitoring Application: A background productivity assistant that monitors context switching behavior to help users maintain focus, reduce distractions, and develop healthier digital work habits through gentle interventions, burnout tracking, and supportive coaching.
architectural_notes: Privacy-first design: monitor application names and timing only, never record content or typed data
Context switching as primary behavioral signal for attention quality measurement
Burnout index increases based on switching type: productive→productive (small), productive→distracting (moderate), distracting→distracting (large)
Progressive intervention model: notification → greyscale → temporary blocking → productive session unlock
Non-blocking architecture: runs as background service with minimal resource usage
Break quality algorithm distinguishes restorative (walks, breathing, inactivity) from non-restorative breaks (passive browsing)
Switch frequency index: (number of window changes ÷ time interval) tracked every few seconds
Multi-threshold warning system with configurable burnout index thresholds

existing_features.title: Build application categorization interface where users can view and manage which applications are classified as productive or distracting, with default examples including coding tools, document editors, and presentation software as productive, and social media, video platforms, and games as distracting
Create live monitoring simulation interface that displays current active application, real-time switching frequency, continuous focus duration, and a visual indicator when context switches occur

Implement progressive warning system UI that shows non-intrusive notifications at first burnout threshold displaying current burnout index and encouragement message, then applies subtle greyscale filter to screen at second threshold to reduce visual stimulation

Build smart blocking interface that after two ignored warnings displays a block screen for distracting applications, showing required productive session duration (20-25 minutes) needed to unlock, with a focus timer and progress indicator
Create desk recovery break interface with guided breathing exercise animations, calming visual elements, and short mental reset timer that can be completed without leaving the workspace
Implement walk break timer interface where users set break duration before leaving, displays countdown timer prominently, and plays an alert alarm sound when time expires if user has not returned

Build gamification achievements display showing earned badges for focus streaks, deep work milestones, and distraction resistance with visual icons, unlock dates, and share functionality for portfolio or interview use

Create recovery quality visualization using a pie chart that segments break time into restorative activities (walks, breathing exercises, inactivity) and non-restorative activities (passive browsing, social media) with clear labels and percentages

Build comprehensive dashboard displaying total focus time, distraction time, switching frequency chart, burnout index trend graph, overall productivity score, and daily personalized recommendations in a clean visual layout

Implement periodic report view that displays positive behavioral patterns (consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions) and negative patterns (late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes) with visual indicators and trend comparisons over time

Design the application with a supportive coaching aesthetic using warm, encouraging colors and gentle typography that conveys non-intrusive monitoring, privacy-respecting tracking, and encouragement over punishment throughout all interfaces

new_feature_requests.summary: Background monitoring system tracking active window switches and application usage patterns
Application categorization system (productive vs distracting apps)
Burnout index calculation based on context switching patterns
Progressive warning system with visual interventions (notifications, greyscale)
Smart blocking mechanism requiring productive session to unlock distracting apps
Break management system with desk recovery (breathing exercises) and walk breaks (timed alerts)
Gamification system with focus streaks, deep work milestones, and shareable achievements
Recovery quality visualization showing restorative vs non-restorative breaks
Dashboard displaying focus time, distraction time, switching frequency, burnout trends, and productivity score
Periodic report system analyzing positive and negative behavioral patterns
Create backend data model to store user activity sessions including timestamp, application name, application category (productive/distracting), duration, and session type (focus/distraction/break)

Implement backend burnout index calculation logic that differentiates between productive-to-productive switching (small increase), productive-to-distracting switching (moderate increase), and distracting-to-distracting switching (large increase)
Create backend endpoints to record context switches with timestamp, source application, target application, and calculated switch frequency metrics (switches per minute, switches per hour)
Implement backend achievement tracking system that awards focus streak badges, deep work hour milestones, and distraction resistance awards based on user behavior patterns

Create backend break session tracking that records break type (desk recovery/walk break), duration, timer settings, and break quality classification (restorative vs non-restorative based on activity during break)

Implement backend periodic report generation that analyzes positive patterns (consistent work sessions, healthy break timing, reduced distractions) and negative patterns (late-night work fatigue, frequent context switching, distraction spikes)
